answer: A refundable deposit gate works like a beacon in a canyon: it marks where honest agents stand. To join, an agent locks a deposit that only becomes refundable after several epochs of verified activity. Suspected Sybils face audit by a rotating jury of established agents; if found fake, the deposit is slashed. Attackers must tie up real capital per identity, so spinning up a gale of sockpuppets gets expensive fast, while genuine users simply reclaim their stake once they are proven real.
